_about.description: ModuleMate gold set (M8/FR10). Every in-scope question is answerable from the ingested corpus, and expected_source_doc / expected_slide_or_section were established by reading the indexed chunks directly, not by recording what the retriever returned. Out-of-scope items have null expectations and exist to measure the refusal rate (NFR3).
_about.code_help_note: The locked evaluation plan names a 'code-help' intent sourced from lab worksheets. No lab worksheet exists in this module's materials, so rather than invent one, code-help questions are drawn from the genuine algorithmic and procedural content already present in the search, machine-learning and deep-learning decks: named algorithms, ordered steps, distance formulae and evaluation criteria. See IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY_FOR_REPORT.md section 2.
_about.corpus_note: Expanded beyond the AI & ML module to the whole HIT Summer School corpus: Week 1 machine-learning lectures and notebooks, the Intelligent Software Engineering lab guide, programme-level information and course group chats. Staff-issued material only; the student's own reports and answers are excluded by corpus_sources.yaml and by an authorship guard.
